verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs claim real-time notifications about email events, which points to a first-party event-webhook capability. The pack never names the specific events, the payload schema, or any signing, and the inbound-email webhook (brevo-docs-8) covers a different use case. Missing for 10: explicit registrable HTTP webhook subscription docs, coverage of sends/opens/clicks/bounces/unsubscribes, a documented payload schema, payload signing/verification, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe webhooks to delivery and engagement events — sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes — with a documented, signed payload

citations.quote: Receive real-time notifications about email events and automate workflows.
